title: Passing
intro: How each team throws the ball and how it defends the pass. ANY/A is adjusted net yards per attempt (touchdowns +20, interceptions −45, sacks count). CPOE, time to throw, aggressiveness (throws into tight windows), intended air yards, air yards to the sticks, receiver separation, cushion and YAC over expected come from NFL Next Gen Stats tracking; bad throws and drops from Pro Football Reference.
